entry.title: Hemingway Classic Sun Grown
entry.summaryHtml: Cedar, leather, toasted wood, caramel, red pepper and citrus peel give the Classic Sun Grown a firmer, spicier edge than the Cameroon-wrapped Natural while retaining the Hemingway line’s aromatic Dominican core. The Ecuadorian sun-grown wrapper adds darker sweetness and pepper around the cedar, with the long perfecto shape allowing the profile to broaden before a woody, savoury-sweet finish.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted. Price follows the catalogue’s existing Hemingway Classic convention of treating one 7-inch cigar as two pre-light sessions.
practicalLines: Pre-cut before lighting into two sessions

note: Add the Sun Grown blend counterpart to the existing Hemingway Classic Natural as a standalone entry. CigarWorld currently lists the exact 7 x 46 Sun Grown single at A$68.18 and available.
